title: Thickness of plaster.
officialText:
The minimum thickness of gypsum plaster or portland cement plaster used in a fire-resis-
tance-rated system shall be determined by the prescribed fire tests. The plaster thickness shall be measured from the face
of the lath where applied to gypsum lath or metal lath.
